description.translate: Sixteen smooth basalt will restore the instrument bed and damaged wall panels. Measurements are only useful when the bench beneath them stops moving. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

Tears for Fears is a sword built to contain an enemy's ability. After The Ranker defeated a Warden, the blade absorbed its call. The shout you may one day hear from it comes from that research. He wanted to learn how much more his artifacts could hold.
